_comment: Extra --rvui-* values a deployed host may carry BEYOND the canonical tokens.css set. Scoped by hostname. Values are normalized (numeric/quote/formatting-insensitive) before comparison, so raw source formatting here is fine. Seeded with the three --rvui-font-* app-level overrides apps/marketing redeclares so its self-hosted @fontsource-variable families (Inter Variable / Inter Tight Variable / JetBrains Mono Variable) lead the stack. Anything not listed here that differs from canonical fails verification.

--rvui-font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, monospace
